text: Dr Lin has 32 runs to review. Six have a signal shift. Help identify the affected evidence and prepare a traceable review report — without editing original values.
title: Meet Dr Lin / 认识林博士

text: Start with one embedded, explicitly artificial RDML file. No laboratory files or internet are needed.
title: Stage the embedded file / 加载模拟文件

text: Watch the real intake read 32 artificial runs and 768 target records. Cq values, amplification curves and melting arrays stay linked.
title: Read the evidence / 读取证据

text: Dr Lin filters sample names before interpretation. Filtering is a view/selection step; it does not rewrite measurements.
title: Narrow the sample scope / 缩小样品范围

text: A named SOP makes rules and report identity traceable. This fictional profile is not a validated method.
title: Create a review-only SOP / 创建审核用 SOP

text: Make thresholds and controls explicit. Absolute, relative and melting configuration fields are also available; a template alone is not a validated calculation method.
title: Specify targets and controls / 设置靶标与质控

text: Inspect one run first. Cq, replicate counts, outcome and reason remain visible together. All values here are artificial.
title: Read the sample outcome / 阅读样品结果

text: Use the experiment selector and text search together. Dr Lin isolates DEMO_SAMPLE_0 instead of reading hundreds of rows.
title: Find one run and sample / 查找一次运行及样品

text: The Control panel separates hardware, software, method and operator signals. Thirty-two compatible artificial runs support a baseline.
title: See the history at a glance / 查看历史概况

text: QuantStudio 5 specifications are manufacturer reference values for the stated block variant. Simulator measurements are labelled separately.
title: Know the hardware reference / 了解硬件参考

text: Chapter 2: investigate the shift. The dark chart makes the stable artificial heating history easy to see.
title: Check heating stability / 检查升温稳定性

text: Cooling can change independently of heating. This light-background example shows the same chart controls and readable limits.
title: Check cooling independently / 单独检查降温

text: The last six runs show a deliberately increasing background. Look at the highlighted red points, not the entire page.
title: Locate the six drifting runs / 定位六次漂移运行

text: The tour presses the real Red alert for this artificial scenario. This scripted click does not add an automatic production alarm rule.
title: Call attention to the drift / 提醒注意漂移

text: Stop remains available even with Sounds collapsed. Then the transcript “two” selects Next chart; no microphone is used.
title: Stop, then try voice Next / 停止警报并模拟下一项

text: The transcript “four” opens View. Numbered choices change with the active menu, matching the displayed keys.
title: Open the voice menu / 打开模拟语音菜单

text: Emulated “one”, then “two” chooses Zoom and Zoom in. The data values do not change.
title: Zoom using two choices / 分两步缩放

text: Compare the artificial sigmoid rises and the flat NTC. Stored Cq and traces stay linked to their sample and channel.
title: Inspect amplification / 检查扩增曲线

text: A high R² is not enough. This light-background standard curve spans only two log units, below the illustrative profile requirement.
title: Read a calibration limitation / 阅读校准限制

text: Two artificial products have supplied Tm values near 78 and 82 °C. The dark preview shows the retained fluorescence arrays.
title: Compare melting evidence / 比较熔解证据

text: Chapter 3: prepare traceable evidence. Check positions, roles and channels before selecting report figures.
title: Verify the plate layout / 核对孔板布局

text: Dr Lin compares compatible samples and replicates rather than mixing targets or protocols.
title: Compare samples / 比较样品

text: Review counts and grouped variability. A single grand Cq mean across different targets is not an assay conclusion.
title: Check grouped statistics / 检查分组统计

text: Instrument records and file integrity explain where values came from. A checksum identifies bytes; it does not certify an experiment.
title: Trace the source evidence / 追溯来源证据

text: Exports preserve evidence and scope. The demo does not silently download files or send data to a server.
title: Choose an open output / 选择开放输出

text: The 12 animals can open pages or specific charts. Dr Lin can bind a shortcut to the drift chart without changing real saved assignments.
title: Make shortcuts useful / 配置实用快捷方式

text: Commands groups modes, status report, Details and GPL/source. The tour shows diagnostics without downloading a file.
title: Keep commands and details together / 集中命令与详情

text: The actual typed workflow supports explicit report selections. The tour does not run a script or trigger a download.
title: Use Command mode / 使用命令模式

text: The dark Console keeps charts large. Mouse, keyboard and optional local voice reach the same navigation and appearance controls.
title: Work in Console / 使用控制台

text: Dr Lin has isolated the drift and prepares two relevant figures for review. The actual PDF is built locally from artificial data. This does not approve results or repair hardware.
title: Prepare the evidence, not a release / 准备证据而非签发结论
